rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for doing or saying something while angry.

example.english: I angrily scolded him and told him not to be late again.
example.traditional: 我嬲住鬧佢，叫佢唔好再遲到。
example.jyutping: ngo5 nau1 zyu6 naau6 keoi5 giu3 keoi5 m4 hou2 zoi3 ci4 dou3

rows.note: Use this when the manner is noticeably cross or mildly sulky rather than intensely furious.

example.english: They angrily packed their schoolbag, saying they were not going to school today.
example.traditional: 佢嬲嬲哋咁執拾書包，話今日唔返學。
example.jyutping: keoi5 nau1 nau1 dei2 gam2 zap1 sap6 syu1 baau1 waa6 gam1 jat6 m4 faan1 hok6
